concept_decisions: Actual concept inspected: retain long ramp and steep lee asymmetry but reject fine tiled rock texture and detached debris skirt. Build single closed integrated terrain mesh with unequal fractured faces at+X lee, long low ramp from-X; broad rounded cross-section. Subtle sparse nonuniform longitudinal grooves in ramp surface rather than drawn texture. Bedrock footing included in same mesh; no ice or signs. Quiet palette-only facets, not regular masonry layers.
